llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration completion is tracked in dedicated atom state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Hydration completion is tracked via useState (local component state), not a dedicated atom. The requirement specifies dedicated atom state.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Preference-dependent content is gated behind a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: if (!hydrated) returns a loading view before rendering preference-dependent content, providing a deterministic pre-hydration UI branch.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Hydration action runs first and profile loading is triggered only after hydration completes
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Inside the useEffect, profile fetch is chained inside the .then() of AsyncStorage.getItem, so it only executes after the storage read resolves and setHydrated(true) is called.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Post-hydration profile load fetches the users endpoint and builds preview text from `firstName` and `lastName`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Fetches https://dummyjson.com/users/1, destructures firstName and lastName from response JSON, and builds preview string `${firstName} ${lastName}`.
evidence: fetch('https://dummyjson.com/users/1').then((r) => r.json()).then((data) => { const { firstName, lastName } = data; setProfile(`${firstName} ${lastName}`) })
